title: Derived Poincare pairing
statement:
In the Poincare duality conventions of this chapter (the fixed setting), let $\Lambda\in\{A,\mathcal O_E,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_{\ell}\}$ and let $K\in D^b_{ctf}(X,\Lambda)$ be perfect over $\Lambda_X$ as in [def-pod-perfect-complex-on-x] (the case $\Lambda=A$ is the finite stage; the other coefficients are its transports). The *derived Poincare pairing* is the composite

$$
\beta _K:\   R\Gamma _c(X,K)\otimes _\Lambda ^LR\Gamma \bigl(X,K^\vee (d)\bigr)[2d] \longrightarrow \Lambda,
$$

$$
\begin{array}{lll} R\Gamma _c(X,K)\otimes _\Lambda ^LR\Gamma \bigl(X,K^\vee (d)\bigr)[2d] & \xrightarrow {\  \smile _c\  }&  R\Gamma _c\bigl(X,K\otimes ^L_{\Lambda _X}K^\vee (d)\bigr)[2d]\\ & \xrightarrow {R\Gamma _c(\operatorname {ev}_K(d))[2d]}&  R\Gamma _c\bigl(X,\Lambda _X(d)\bigr)[2d]\\ & \xrightarrow {\  \operatorname {Tr}^{\mathrm{sm}}_{a_X,\Lambda }\  }&  \Lambda, \end{array}
$$

where $\smile _c$ is the mixed-support cup product, $\operatorname {ev}_K$ is the evaluation of [def-pod-coefficient-dual-on-x], and $\operatorname {Tr}^{\mathrm{sm}}_{a_X,\Lambda }$ is the normalized smooth trace of the purity chapter for the structure morphism $a_X$, i.e. the counit of $Ra_{X!}\dashv Ra_X^!$ through the canonical orientation $\eta _X$. None of these ingredients uses properness: the cup product and the trace only involve $Ra_{X!}$, $Ra_{X*}$ and $Ra_X^!$ for the separated finite-type smooth morphism $a_X$.

split_report.summary: Checked the current main-20261015 definition and retained its complete three-arrow composite without properness. Existing definitions supply the conventions, site-perfectness, coefficient dual/evaluation, mixed-support cup, and finite-stage normalized trace; the existing purity corollary supplies the other three coefficient traces. No new node is needed. Related blueprint formulations are recorded in same_as. The orientation-based etale Lean definitions do not cover the normalized four-stage pro-etale definition. The resumed worker read every statement input and reran all four Mathlib search kinds in two phrasings, including successful Loogle searches, with exact logged queries. Repair of the returned landing: reread all six current statement inputs, especially the updated def-pod-perfect-complex-on-x and its site-perfect coefficient-stage interpretation. Bound the perfectness hypothesis explicitly to that existing definition; the three maps, hypotheses and coefficient categories are unchanged. Revalidated the finite-projective, completed integral, localized rational and common finite-extension interpretations, without substituting dualizability or ordinary constant non-torsion sheaves. Maintainer review (2026-10-17): the first arrow applies the mixed-support cup product, which takes L in D^b_ctf, to L=K^vee(d); its well-definedness is now cited by name: lem-pod-coefficient-dual-perfect gives K^vee perfect and in D^b_ctf, and thm-sf-ctf-stability ((ii) at the finite stage, (vii) at the integral, rational and common stages) keeps the twist K^vee(d)=K^vee tensor Lambda_X(d) in D^b_ctf.

At O_E, E and Q̄_ℓ, cor-pur-adic-and-rational-smooth-dualizing-complexes supplies the transported normalized integration map; the coefficient categories agree.
